teaser.en: One of the world's most widespread plants, and one of its more poisonous ferns.
teaser.sw: Mmoja wa mimea iliyoenea zaidi duniani, na mojawapo ya vivumbasi vyenye sumu zaidi.
teaser.dg: Mwenga wa mimea inayomera phatu phanji zaidi duniani, na mwenga wa *fern* zenye sumu zaidi.

summary.en: This Mvwiko is bracken, a tall, tough fern that forms dense stands on open and burnt ground. Pakia gives it the same Digo name as the lacy fern Davallia.
summary.sw: Mvwiko huu ni *bracken*, kivumbasi kirefu na kigumu kinachoota kwa wingi kama kichaka kwenye ardhi wazi na iliyochomwa moto. Pakia anaupa jina lile lile la Kidigo kama kivumbasi maridadi Davallia.
summary.dg: *Mvwiko* uhu ni *bracken*, *fern* ndefu yenye nguvu inayomera kpwa makundi manji phatu pha kpwereru na phatu phariphotsomwa moho. Pakia anaupha dzina ra Chidigo sawa na ra *fern* ya makodza ganagoganyika sana, *Davallia*.

about.en: Bracken grows from deep, spreading underground stems, sending up single, tall, stiff fronds that can reach head height. Each frond is broad and triangular, divided two or three times into many small leaflets, and the young fronds uncurl like fiddle heads. The spores form along the rolled-under leaf edges.
about.sw: Bracken huota kutoka mashina ya chini ya ardhi yaliyo ndani na yanayoenea, ukichipuza jani moja moja refu na gumu linaloweza kufikia kimo cha kichwa cha mtu. Kila jani ni pana lenye umbo la pembetatu, limegawanyika mara mbili au tatu kuwa vijani vingi vidogo, na majani machanga hujikunjua kama kichwa cha fidla. Vijimbegu (spora) hutokea kando ya kingo za majani zilizojikunja kwa chini.
about.dg: *Bracken* inamera kula kpwa seemu za tsini zinazotandazika tsini sana (*rhizomes*), na inalavya makodza (*fronds*) mire na magumu, chila rimwenga macheye, ganagoweza kufika urefu wa chitswa cha mutu. Chila kodza ni pana na ra umbo ra pembe tahu, na rinaganyika mara mbiri au tahu kukala makodza madide manji; makodza maphya ganavuguka pore-pore kula kpwa umbo ra kudzizunguluka. Mbeyu ndide sana (*spores*) zinamera kanda-kanda ya makodza, phatu kanda zinaphogaluka photsi.

where.en: It is found almost worldwide. In Kenya it forms thickets on open, burnt or cleared land, forest edges and higher, wetter ground, often on acid soils.
where.sw: Hupatikana karibu kila mahali duniani. Nchini Kenya huunda vichaka kwenye ardhi wazi, iliyochomwa moto au iliyosafishwa, pembezoni mwa misitu na kwenye nyanda za juu zenye unyevu zaidi, mara nyingi kwenye udongo wenye asidi.
where.dg: Inaphahikana phephi kpwa chila phatu duniani. Kenya inahenda vitsaka kpwenye tsi ya kpwereru, iriyotsomwa moho au iriyotemwa, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye tsi ya dzulu yenye mvula nyinji, mara nyinji kpwenye ulongo wa ngbwadu.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Bracken contains compounds that are poisonous to livestock and are linked to cancer, so it is not a safe plant to eat, even though young fronds are eaten in some parts of the world.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Bracken ina viambato vyenye sumu kwa mifugo na vinavyohusishwa na saratani, kwa hiyo si mmea salama kuliwa, ingawa majani yake machanga huliwa katika baadhi ya sehemu za dunia.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Chidigo. *Bracken* ina kemikali zenye sumu kpwa mifugo, na zinahusiana na ukongo wa saratani (*cancer*), kpwa hivyo si mmea salama wa kurya, dzagbwe makodza maphya nkuriwa kpwenye seemu zanjina za dunia.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mvwiko, 'floaters'. The meaning and the use as bucket floaters are recorded for the lacy fern Davallia chaerophylloides, which shares the name. In English it is bracken; its scientific name is Pteridium aquilinum.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mvwiko, 'vielea'. Maana hiyo na matumizi ya kuelea ndooni yameripotiwa kwa kivumbasi maridadi Davallia chaerophylloides, kinachoshiriki jina hilo. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *bracken*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Pteridium aquilinum.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mvwiko*, 'vitu vinavyoelea'. Pakia anaandika mana hino na kuhumirwa dza vitu vya kuelea ndooni kpwa *fern* ya makodza ganagoganyika sana, *Davallia chaerophylloides*, ambayo ina dzina hiri hiri. Kpwa Chingereza ni *bracken*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Pteridium aquilinum*.
